'''Cade Cummins''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 29th at [[2001 Normal DPC]] on 24 February 2001, according to Michael Raveling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1814">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-normal-2001d1814/ normal-2001], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 27 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-normal-2001d1814/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
